name: Robosaurus
def: Giant driver operated robot, built in 1989 by inventor Doug Malewicki, that changes from a 48 foot semi trailer into a Tyrannosaurus rex that devours cars at shows.
facts: The driver sits inside the robot's head
Has hydraulic arms, claws and jaws plus a flamethrower in its head
Originally owned and run by Malewicki's company, Monster Robots, Inc.
